title: Account
subtitle: How you sign in, your data, and closing your account. These settings follow you into every workspace you belong to.

twoStep.title: Two-step verification
twoStep.body: After your password, sign-in also asks for a code from an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…). Someone who learns your password still can't get in.
twoStep.scan1: Open your authenticator app and add an account.
twoStep.scan2: Scan this QR code with it.
twoStep.scan3: Type the 6-digit code the app shows.
twoStep.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key in the app instead:
twoStep.codesBody: If you lose your phone, each of these lets you sign in once. Keep them somewhere safe, like a password manager. They won't be shown again.
twoStep.fileHeading: Vertex Connect recovery codes. Each works once.
twoStep.confirmDisable: Enter a code from your app, or a recovery code, to turn two-step verification off.
twoStep.confirmRegenerate: Enter a code from your app to get new recovery codes. The old ones stop working.

devices.title: Where you're signed in
devices.body: Each browser and phone signed in to your account. Sign out any you don't recognise, or that you no longer use. We email you when a new device signs in.
devices.confirmOthers_one: Sign out the other device? It will have to sign in again.
devices.confirmOthers_other: Sign out the {{count}} other devices? They will have to sign in again.
devices.signedOutOthers_one: The other device was signed out.

data.title: Your data
data.body: Download a copy of everything your account holds: your profile, the workspaces you're in, your cards, the leads from your cards or assigned to you with their history, and your notifications.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: Closes your account for good. This can't be undone.
delete.blockedTitle: First, hand over the workspaces you own
delete.blocker_one: {{name}}: you're its only owner and {{count}} other person uses it
delete.blocker_other: {{name}}: you're its only owner and {{count}} other people use it
delete.blockedHow: On the Team page, make someone else an owner, or remove the other members. Then come back here.
delete.withIt: Deleted with your account, as no one else uses them: {{names}}. They're kept for 30 days in case it was a mistake, then erased.
delete.leaving: You leave {{names}}. Your cards there go offline, and your leads and chips stay with the team, unassigned.
delete.erased: Your name, email, photo and sign-in methods are erased now, and you're signed out everywhere.
delete.code: Code from your authenticator app (or a recovery code)
